question: How do I report an outage?

emissions.source: Synthetic seasonal dispatch fixture; not measured emissions

knowledge_base.title: Report an outage
knowledge_base.text: Synthetic support guidance: report an outage through the utility reporting channel. Stay away from fallen wires; contact local emergency services for immediate danger. Life-safety reports receive critical priority. Internal routing uses SYN-SUB-WINTER.

knowledge_base.title: Meter consumption intervals
knowledge_base.text: Synthetic meter readings describe energy consumed during each half-hour interval in kWh. Winter heating can increase consumption.
